install.command: curl -fsSL https://srift.app/install.sh | sh  # Windows: irm https://srift.app/install.ps1 | iex

authentication.note: Local daemon binds to 127.0.0.1; no tokens required.

tools.name: srift_quick_share
tools.description: Zero-install file delivery: returns a public https://srift.app/d/<token> relay link the recipient can fetch with any HTTP client (browser, srift get, wget, curl). Bytes stream from this machine on demand; nothing is stored on a server. Params: filePath (file or folder) or filePaths[] (several: one .tar.gz link, or bundle:false for one link per path created in parallel), bundleName?, exclude?, sessionName?, maxDownloads?, ttlMs?, encrypt?, password?. Works in sandboxes: srift mcp runs the daemon in-process (outbound 443 only) when it cannot start.
